title: Deep-learning allosteric-site prediction identifies celestolide as Botrytis CYP51 inhibitor
summary: Celestolide inhibited CYP51 (IC50 133.28 ug/mL), showed antifungal activity and extended strawberry shelf life by more than a week in a gray-mold model. IC50 is weak in absolute terms; abstract only; field efficacy untested.
ai_technology: Neural relational inference and CorrSite2.0 (Gaussian network deep learning model)
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

source_review.scope: Abstract and metadata via Europe PMC; full text not read

evidence.tested: Celestolide inhibited CYP51 (IC50 133.28 ug/mL), showed antifungal activity and extended strawberry shelf life by more than a week in a gray-mold model.
evidence.unknown: IC50 is weak in absolute terms; abstract only; field efficacy untested.
evidence.ai_role: Models identified the allosteric site used to select celestolide.
